name: Affection Subdomain
body:
Associated Domain: Hope

Replacement Power: The following granted power replaces the word of hope power of the hope domain.

Loving Ward (Su)

You can, out of the love in your heart, protect another from harm as an immediate action. Any hit point damage the target takes is halved for 1 round. The amount of damage not taken by the target is transferred to you and may not be reduced by any resistance or DR you might have. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Replacement Domain Spell: 2nd–suppress charms and compulsions
